description: Configuration for online giving and contribution statements.

fields.description: Shows the giving form on the /give page. Needs the Payments app and a payment gateway. When unchecked, the page shows an "unavailable" notice and rejects new gifts.
fields.label: Enable Online Giving

fields.description: When unchecked, visitors must log in before giving so the gift links to their Person.
fields.label: Allow Anonymous (Guest) Giving

fields.description: Offered on the Give page and for sign-up and form payments. Mark one row as the default.
fields.label: Payment Gateways

fields.description: Pre-selected fund on the giving page. Leave blank to let the giver choose.
fields.label: Default Fund

fields.default: Thank you for your generous gift!
fields.description: Shown on the giving page after a successful payment.
fields.label: Thank You Message

fields.description: Bank transfer, standing order or mailing details. The Give page shows this text below the form, also when online giving is off.
fields.label: Other Ways to Give

fields.description: Household combines the giving of everyone in a Family onto one statement.
fields.label: Group Statements By

fields.default: No goods or services were provided in exchange for these contributions.
fields.description: Printed at the foot of every statement. US churches need this wording for gifts of $250 or more (IRS Publication 1771).
fields.label: Acknowledgment Text

fields.description: Add a row for a church that needs its own wording. Without one it uses the text above.
fields.label: Wording Per Church

name: Giving Settings
